claims.text: The Congress Working Committee demanded the resignations of Prime Minister Narendra Modi, Union Home Minister Amit Shah, and Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar, accusing them of orchestrating voter roll manipulation.
The Congress Working Committee demanded an immediate halt to the Special Intensive Revision process and the restoration of over 13 crore voters deleted from the electoral rolls.
Rahul Gandhi stated during the CWC meeting that the 2024 Lok Sabha elections were unambiguously match-fixed and referred to Narendra Modi as an illegal PM.
Congress President Mallikarjun Kharge caustically asked MP Shashi Tharoor whether he would join the street battle against the Election Commission or only appear on television and in newspapers.
Trinamool Congress leader Mamata Banerjee arrived in New Delhi accompanied by MPs Dola Sen and Kalyan Banerjee to participate in the INDIA bloc meeting.
Mamata Banerjee told media persons in Delhi that she has been addressing Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar as Vanish Kumar.
CPI(M) General Secretary M. A. Baby reached out to Mamata Banerjee to forge unity among opposition parties regarding the special intensive revision of electoral rolls.
Suvendu Adhikari accused Mamata Banerjee of going to Delhi to hold a planning session with Dimagi Naxals.

The Indian Express reported that Election Commissioners Sukhbir Singh Sandhu and Vivek Joshi formally objected 14 times in 10 months to decisions by the poll panel regarding the Special Intensive Revision.
Election Commissioner Sukhbir Singh Sandhu stated in a written objection that the poll panel acted against the advice of both commissioners, describing the action as unauthorised and illegal.
The Election Commission rejected reports of an internal rift, stating that differences of opinion are a normal part of its deliberations.
The Congress resolution called for the restoration of 13.3 crore names that it stated had been removed from electoral rolls as part of the voter list revision process.
A Hindustan Times analysis showed that draft electoral rolls in Delhi saw a 32.8 percent decline from the 14,510,299 names listed as of June 2026.
Congress President Mallikarjun Kharge accused Prime Minister Narendra Modi of destroying democracy through a conspiracy of vote-demonetisation.
Congress General Secretary K.C. Venugopal announced that the party will launch a massive agitation at state and district levels in coordination with INDIA bloc allies.
Four CISF personnel were killed at the NHPC Sewa-III hydel project in Kathua's Basohli area after a colleague opened fire following an argument.
CISF Head Constable Abhidesh Kumar was overpowered by colleagues and arrested after the shooting, and his service weapon was seized.
The four victims of the Kathua shooting were identified as Assistant Commandant Ankit Kumar Pandey, Sub-Inspector Lakshman Singh, Constable Sanjeev Kumar, and Constable Mohammed Rafiq.
On August 14, Village Defence Guard Surjeet Singh shot dead a colleague and critically injured another following a scuffle in Udhampur.
The accused CISF Head Constable involved in the Kathua shooting is a 2009-batch officer.
The four injured CISF personnel were taken to the NHPC Hospital on the Himachal Pradesh side, where all four succumbed to their injuries.
Security forces launched joint search operations across a dozen locations in Rajouri, Poonch, and Kathua following reports of suspicious movements.
Kathua Senior Superintendent of Police Mohita Sharma confirmed that four CISF personnel guarding the Sewa-III power project on the Sewa River were killed in a suspected case of fratricide.
Accused CISF Head Constable Abhidesh Singh used an AK-47 rifle to open fire on his colleagues.
